mapper.sql: salary_uuid, id, employee_uuid, salary_month, department, scheduled_days, actual_days, leave_days, base_salary, position_allowance, overtime_pay, bonus, subsidy, other_pay, social_insurance, housing_fund, tax_amount, tax_rate, gross_pay, net_pay, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `employee_salary_record` (salary_uuid, employee_uuid, salary_month, department, scheduled_days, actual_days, leave_days, base_salary, position_allowance, overtime_pay, bonus, subsidy, other_pay, social_insurance, housing_fund, tax_amount, tax_rate, gross_pay, net_pay, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{salaryUuid}, #{employeeUuid}, #{salaryMonth}, #{department}, #{scheduledDays}, #{actualDays}, #{leaveDays}, #{baseSalary}, #{positionAllowance}, #{overtimePay}, #{bonus}, #{subsidy}, #{otherPay}, #{socialInsurance}, #{housingFund}, #{taxAmount}, #{taxRate}, #{grossPay}, #{netPay}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `employee_salary_record` WHERE employee_uuid = #{employeeUuid} ORDER BY salary_month DESC, id DESC
